一切都要适度：多域训练中的每个域覆盖最优和抗对齐域差距Everything in Moderation: Per-Domain Coverage Optima and Alignment-Resistant Domain Gaps in Multi-Domain Mid-Training

Yunpeng Xu Affiliation: Kun Zheng
摘要Abstract

训练中期（预训练和对齐之间的阶段）是模型的每个域数据组成通常由数据可用性而不是原则设计决定的阶段。我们询问这个决定会带来什么，以及以后的调整是否可以撤销它。在受控逻辑推理设置（Qwen3-8B-Base 主，具有 4B 复制；五个语义上规则不相交的 KOR-Bench 域）中，我们训练跨越五域单纯形的 30 个分配 - 24 个扫描配置加上 6 个从拟合中保留的配置 - 每个分配有 5 个种子。出现了三个发现。首先，Mid-training—the stage between pre-training and alignment—is where a model’s per-domain data composition is usually decided by data availability rather than principled design. We ask what that decision buys and whether a later alignment pass can undo it. In a controlled logical-reasoning setting (Qwen3-8B-Base primary, with a 4B replication; five semantically rule-disjoint KOR-Bench domains) we train 30 allocations spanning the five-domain simplex—24 sweep configurations plus six withheld from the fit—at five seeds each. Three findings emerge. First,每个域都有一个最佳的内部覆盖范围every domain has an interior coverage optimum：中等频段（: the moderate band (1010–40%40\%）对于所有五个域都是最好的（描述性带一致性；二次内部性的校准排列测试给出) is best for all five domains (a descriptive band concordance; a calibrated permutation test for quadratic interiority givesP≈0.010P\approx 0.010、附录, AppendixF.1），以及拟合的仅训练中期曲线，其间有 8B 个峰值), and the fitted mid-training-only curves, with 8B peaks between9.9%9.9\%和and35.1%35.1\%，再现样本外的曲线形状（不是峰值位置）。第二，, reproduce out-of-sample for the curve shape (not the peak locations). Second,固定预算调整通过后仍存在差距the gaps survive a fixed-budget alignment pass：补偿性 SFT 增加 116/120 个细胞（平均: compensatory SFT raises 116/120 cells (mean+4.32+4.32pp）还有桥梁pp) yet bridges0/2400/240对在一个pairs at a55pp 阈值且仅pp threshold and only30/24030/240在一个at a10%10\%比率，等预算统一控制的行为几乎相同，并且随机重新分配相同增益的排列零将桥接ratio, an equal-budget uniform control behaves almost identically, and a permutation null reallocating the same gains at random would bridge13.8±3.313.8\pm 3.3和and77.9±8.577.9\pm 8.5对（pairs (P<0.001P<0.001）。第三，零覆盖率崩溃了仅训练中的准确性，并且测试的配方扭转了这两个迹象 - 对于操作来说显然是这样，对于反事实来说则无法解决 - 尽管仅 FineWeb-Edu 的控制显示崩溃与通用分布漂移混合在一起。一个探索性的). Third, zero coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy, and the tested recipe reverses both signs—clearly for Operation, not resolvably for Counterfactual—though a FineWeb-Edu-only control shows the collapse is co-mingled with generic distributional drift. An exploratoryθ∗\theta^{*}分配获得了三个经过训练的端到端的最大全管道增益（allocation attains the largest full-pipeline gain of the three trained end-to-end (+4.36+4.36与vs.+0.80+0.80/+0.64+0.64pp)，但在未校正的韦尔奇测试下处于边缘状态，并且是从同一扫描中选择的。由于单纯形上的覆盖范围有所不同，因此五个最佳值是混合级别边缘，而不是一个联合最佳混合的坐标。pp) but is marginal under an uncorrected Welch test and is selected from the same sweep. Because coverage varies on a simplex, the five optima are mixture-level marginals, not the coordinates of one jointly optimal mixture.

1 简介Introduction

多阶段训练范式（预训练The multi-stage training paradigm (pre-training→\rightarrow训练中期mid-training→\rightarrow监督微调 (SFT)Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)→\rightarrow强化学习（RL））假设每个阶段都为下一阶段的完善奠定了基础。但一些早期的设计选择可能会产生后期阶段无法消除的限制。本文测试了一项特定决策的可能性：Reinforcement Learning (RL)) assumes each stage provides a foundation the next can refine. But some early design choices may create constraints that later stages cannot undo. This paper tests that possibility for one specific decision:训练中期每个域的数据覆盖率per-domain data coverage at mid-training。训练中期（预训练和对齐之间的阶段）是一种通用的领域适应技术，但每个领域的数据组成通常是由数据可用性而不是原则设计来设置的。我们研究，在固定的总代币混合物和固定的下游配方中，与覆盖率相关的差异是否会随后通过 SFT 或 RL 减少；我们并不将这项研究视为一般调整程序是否可以修复覆盖范围差距的测试。. Mid-training—the stage between pre-training and alignment—is a general domain-adaptation technique, yet per-domain data composition is typically set by data availability rather than principled design. We study whether, in a fixed total-token mixture and a fixed downstream recipe, coverage-associated differences are subsequently reduced by SFT or RL; we do not treat this study as a test of whether alignment procedures in general can repair coverage gaps.

之前的工作已经部分探讨了这个问题，但未测试覆盖范围分配维度：Prior work has partially explored this question but leaves the coverage-allocation dimension untested:Zhang et al. (2025)显示预训练暴露决定了小型合成环境中的 RL 泛化，showed pretraining exposure determines RL generalization in a small synthetic setting,Zhao et al. (2025)RL 放大了预训练的行为，SFT/RL 文献中 SFT 主要教授格式，而 RL 从现有能力中进行概括that RL amplifies pretrained behaviors, and the SFT/RL literature that SFT primarily teaches format while RL generalizes from existing capabilities(Chu et al., 2025);中期培训工作将持续的预培训视为通往下游调整的桥梁; mid-training work treats continued pretraining as a bridge to downstream alignment(Tu et al., 2025)和数据混合方法—DoReMi, and data-mixture methods—DoReMi(Xie et al., 2023a), 正则混合, RegMix(Liu et al., 2025)—优化总体困惑度的域比例。这些都没有变化—optimize domain proportions for aggregate perplexity. None of these varies每个领域的中期培训覆盖率per-domain mid-training coverage同时保持后续阶段固定（附录while holding subsequent stages fixed (AppendixA).

我们通过使用 KOR-Bench 中的五个逻辑推理域对 Qwen3-8B-Base 进行对照研究来解决这一差距We address this gap through a controlled study on Qwen3-8B-Base using five logical-reasoning domains from KOR-Bench(Ma et al., 2025);这些域在语义上是规则不相交的——每个域都定义了一个独立的符号系统——这减少了语义转移的混淆，尽管它们在统计或神经上不是独立的（§; these domains are semantically rule-disjoint—each defines a self-contained symbolic system—which reduces semantic-transfer confounding, though they are not statistically or neurally independent (§3.1）。我们构建了跨越五域单纯形的 24 个覆盖配置——从严重不平衡到平衡再到反偏斜——并保持计划的下游阶段固定。覆盖范围是预期的分配变量，但改变一个组成部分必然会改变其他组成部分，还可能改变有效的重复和多样性。我们在 KOR-Bench 和三个外部基准（CounterBench). We construct 24 coverage configurations spanning the five-domain simplex—from severely imbalanced to balanced to counter-skewed—and hold the planned downstream stages fixed. Coverage is the intended allocation variable, but changing one component necessarily changes the others and may also alter effective repetition and diversity. We evaluate on KOR-Bench and three external benchmarks (CounterBench(Chen et al., 2026), 校对员, ProofWriter(Tafjord et al., 2021), 斑马逻辑, ZebraLogic(Lin et al., 2025)）；出现了三项发现（图); three findings emerge (Figure1;各节中的证据; evidence in Sections4.1–4.4），每个都针对测试设置进行说明，并标有六个保留分配支持样本外的内容。), each stated for the tested setting and marked by what the six withheld allocations support out-of-sample.

2 方法论Methodology

我们修复了跨配置的计划后续训练阶段（SFT、RL），因此训练中期覆盖是预期的干预。推理基准在§中描述We fix the planned subsequent training stages (SFT, RL) across configurations so mid-training coverage is the intended intervention. The reasoning benchmarks are described in §3.1.

2.1 训练阶段Training Stages

我们研究了一个多阶段流程，包括中间训练、随后的 SFT 和 RL；我们的重点不是配方本身，而是训练中期数据分布如何塑造后来的行为。We study a multi-stage pipeline consisting of mid-training followed by SFT and RL; our focus is not the recipe itself, but how the mid-training data distribution shapes later behavior.

训练中期。Mid-training.

让Letθ0\theta_{0}是基本模型参数。训练中期在语料库上执行标准的持续因果语言建模be the base model parameters. Mid-training performs standard continued causal language modeling on a corpus𝒟mid\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{mid}}，产生检查点, yielding checkpointθmid\theta_{\mathrm{mid}}，它初始化后续阶段。, which initializes subsequent stages.

监督微调。Supervised fine-tuning.

SFT 遵循标准指令调整范例，优化问题响应对上的条件下一个标记可能性SFT optimizes conditional next-token likelihood over problem-response pairs, following the standard instruction-tuning paradigm(Wang et al., 2023)。对于 Mid-training+SFT+RL 配置，SFT 从. For the Mid-training+SFT+RL configuration, SFT starts fromθmid\theta_{\mathrm{mid}};对于 SFT+RL 基线（无中间训练），它直接从; for the SFT+RL baseline (no mid-training), it starts directly fromθ0\theta_{0}.

RL：GSPO。RL: GSPO.

SFT之后，我们应用基于组的序列级策略优化（GSPO）After SFT, we apply Group-based Sequence-level Policy Optimization (GSPO)(Yang et al., 2025)，具有二元验证者奖励的序列级基于组的 RL（, a sequence-level group-based RL with binary verifier rewards (Ri=1R_{i}=1如果正确的话if correct,00否则）；完整的方程在附录中otherwise); full equations are in AppendixC.1.

2.2 数据建设Data Construction

管道（图The pipeline (Figure6、附录, AppendixC.8）通过七个编号的组件进行——a) proceeds through seven numbered components—a规则库rule library（方框1），一个(box 1), a域调度程序domain dispatcher(2)、一个(2), a规则合成器rule synthesizer(3)、一个(3), a难度采样器difficulty sampler(4)、一个(4), a确定性求解器deterministic solver（5a），一个(5a), a验证verification阶段(6)，以及stage (6), and a数据预处理器data preprocessor(7)——在我们的运行中，所有答案和轨迹都来自确定性求解器；可选的(7)—and in our runs all answers and traces arise from the deterministic solver; the optional教师模型teacher model这里没有使用分支（框 5b）。branch (box 5b) was not used here.

训练数据是The training data are新合成的实例newly synthesised instances来自基准规则定义，而不是重用基准项目：分割隔离（KOR-Bench 按实例 ID；ProofWriter 按深度）和格式/信息重复数据删除保证没有训练实例与评估项目重合（附录derived from the benchmark rule definitions, not reused benchmark items: split isolation (by instance ID for KOR-Bench; by depth for ProofWriter) and format/information deduplication guarantee that no training instance coincides with an evaluation item (AppendixE).

除了管道机制之外，两个语料库级别的设计选择也值得注意。训练中期控制代币暴露而不是样本计数，并使用固定的总代币预算（Beyond the pipeline mechanics, two corpus-level design choices are notable. Mid-training controls token exposure rather than sample counts and uses a fixed total token budget (≈\approx1.5B 代币，两个纪元；表1.5B tokens, two epochs; Table4），内部五域组件和固定外部组件的固定令牌混合。外部组件通过相同的符号管道生成、验证和过滤；它不包含原始基准项目，并且大约三分之一的代币（34.8％）源自ProofWriter规则系列，这就是为什么我们将ProofWriter视为同族暴露而不是零暴露转移测试（§), a fixed-token mixture of the internal five-domain component and a fixed external component. The external component was generated, verified, and filtered through the same symbolic pipeline; it contains no original benchmark items, and roughly a third of its tokens (34.8%) derive from the ProofWriter rule family, which is why we treat ProofWriter as a same-family exposure rather than a zero-exposure transfer test (§4.4）。仅 FineWeb-Edu 基线（§). The FineWeb-Edu-only baseline (§4.1) 使用与 FineWeb-Edu 相同的总预算来代替内部组件； SFT 轨迹由相同的符号求解器生成，而不是由任何 LLM 生成（代币共享摘要：附录) uses the same total budget with FineWeb-Edu in place of the internal component; SFT traces are generated by the same symbolic solvers—not by any LLM (token-share summary: AppendixD).

2.3 覆盖范围量化Coverage Quantification

我们通过令牌份额而不是样本计数来衡量每个域的中间训练暴露，因为令牌预测决定了学习信号，并且样本比率会低估较长形式的痕迹。领域覆盖范围We measure per-domain mid-training exposure by token share rather than sample count, since token prediction determines the learning signal and longer-form traces would be understated by sample ratios. Domain coverageCov⁡(d)\mathrm{Cov}(d)是来自域的训练中期令牌总数的分数is the fraction of total mid-training tokens from domaindd。这里的覆盖范围仅表示代币分配；它不是对独特示例、数据质量、任务难度或独立可操作剂量的直接衡量。我们跟踪两个增量：. Here coverage denotes token allocation only; it is not a direct measure of unique examples, data quality, task difficulty, or an independently manipulable dose. We track two deltas:Δmid​(d)=Accmidtrain+sft+rl​(d)−Accsft+rl​(d)\Delta_{\mathrm{mid}}(d)=\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{midtrain+sft+rl}}(d)-\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{sft+rl}}(d)（训练中期的净效果）和(net mid-training effect) andΔrl​(d)=Accmidtrain+sft+rl​(d)−Accmidtrain+sft​(d)\Delta_{\mathrm{rl}}(d)=\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{midtrain+sft+rl}}(d)-\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{midtrain+sft}}(d)（RL 贡献）；评估协议详情见附录(RL contribution); evaluation protocol details are in AppendixB.

3 实验装置Experimental Setup

3.1 推理基准Reasoning Benchmarks

主要基准：KOR-Bench。Primary benchmark: KOR-Bench.

我们主要使用 KOR-Bench，一个知识正交推理的结构化基准We mainly use KOR-Bench, a structured benchmark for knowledge-orthogonal reasoning(Ma et al., 2025)。它跨越五个领域——密码、自定义数学运算、形式逻辑、约束难题和反事实推理——每个领域包含 25 种规则类型，并在三个难度级别上提供可验证的真实答案。. It spans five domains—ciphers, custom mathematical operations, formal logic, constraint puzzles, and counterfactual reasoning—each comprising 25 rule types with verifiable ground-truth answers across three difficulty levels.

KOR-Bench 的核心属性是A central property of KOR-Bench is语义规则不相交semantic rule-disjointness：每个域定义了一个独立的符号系统。这减少了语义转移混淆，但并不使域在统计或神经意义上独立——它们仍然共享语言、标记化、输出格式、模型参数和潜在的一般推理程序——因此我们将每个域的覆盖范围视为受控混合坐标，而不是近似独立的因果变量。因为我们的语料库是根据 KOR-Bench 自己的规则定义生成的（新实例，而不是原始项目），所以 KOR-Bench 是我们分布内的主要指标；外部基准是唯一的泛化探针（提供有限的一致性检查）。: each domain defines a self-contained symbolic system. This reduces semantic-transfer confounding but does not make the domains independent in the statistical or neural sense—they still share language, tokenization, output formats, model parameters, and potentially general reasoning procedures—so we treat per-domain coverage as a controlled mixture coordinate, not an approximately independent causal variable. Because our corpus is generated from KOR-Bench’s own rule definitions (fresh instances, never the original items), KOR-Bench is our in-distribution primary metric; the external benchmarks are the only generalization probes (providing limited consistency checks).

外部基准。External benchmarks.

我们还评估了三个外部基准作为有限的一致性检查：We additionally evaluate on three external benchmarks as limited consistency checks:校样员ProofWriter (Tafjord et al., 2021)（演绎推理；D5暴露在固定语料库中，而D6-D9则通过深度保留），(deductive reasoning; D5 is exposed in the fixed corpus, while D6–D9 are held out by depth),斑马逻辑ZebraLogic (Lin et al., 2025)多项选择 (MC) 和网格（约束满足难题），以及Multiple Choice (MC) and Grid (constraint-satisfaction puzzles), and柜台凳CounterBench (Chen et al., 2026)（零直接 KOR-Bench 覆盖）。这些基准在暴露和结构相似性方面有所不同，因此没有一个基准被视为明确的独立转移测试。(zero direct KOR-Bench coverage). These benchmarks differ in exposure and structural similarity, so none is treated as a definitive independent transfer test.

4.3 横向比较：对齐能否缩小训练中的差距？Horizontal Comparison: Can Alignment Close Mid-Training Gaps?

我们使用两种变体来测试将 SFT 数据重新加权到覆盖不足的域是否可以纠正训练中期安装的不平衡：补偿性 SFT（在固定代币预算下对覆盖不足的域进行加权）和统一 SFT（相同的数据混合，作为基线）。此处和附录中描述了两种通行证We test whether reweighting SFT data toward under-covered domains can correct the imbalance installed at mid-training, using two variants: compensatory SFT (weighted toward coverage-deficient domains under a fixed token budget) and uniform SFT (identical data mix, serving as a baseline). Both passes are described here and in AppendixG.

补偿性 SFT。Compensatory SFT.

4.4 外部评估和有限的一致性检查External Evaluation and Limited Consistency Checks

5 讨论Discussion

第一个发现是，覆盖范围引起的差距在特定的、可测试的意义上对对齐预算是稳健的：固定预算补偿性 SFT 通行证使它们基本上完好无损，而等预算统一 SFT 控制的行为几乎相同，因此非封闭性不是补偿公式的属性。三个进一步的结果定位了它的来源：排列 null（附录The first finding is that the coverage-induced gaps are robust to the alignment budget in a specific, testable sense: a fixed-budget compensatory SFT pass leaves them essentially intact, and an equal-budget uniform-SFT control behaves almost identically, so the non-closure is not a property of the compensation formula. Three further results locate where it comes from: the permutation null (AppendixG.2)表明收益是以保留缺口的方式放置的；锐化扫描（附录) shows the gains are placed in a gap-preserving way; the sharpening sweep (AppendixG.3）表明关闭是可以实现的，但只能通过交易大约一半的平均收益来实现；六个保留的分配再现了样本外的整个模式，包括强化学习之后。这并不符合普遍的说法，即调整无法修复承保选择：我们测试了一个保单系列、一个预算和一个短的 RL 支线（) shows closure is attainable, but only by trading roughly half the mean gain for it; and the six held-out allocations reproduce the whole pattern out-of-sample, including after RL. What this does not license is the general claim that alignment cannot repair coverage choices: we tested one policy family, one budget, and a short RL leg (+1.1+1.1 to +2.3+2.3pp；附录pp; AppendixC.6）。有两个观察结果证明了这一点。首先，检查点级负迁移：即使基础模型已经表现良好，零覆盖率也会导致仅训练中期的准确性；经过测试的配方部分修复了这个问题（表). Two observations qualify the picture. First, checkpoint-level negative transfer: zero coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy even where the base model already performs well; the tested recipe partly repairs this (Table6），以及仅限 FineWeb-Edu 的控件（§), and the FineWeb-Edu-only control (§5.3）表明崩溃与一般分布漂移混合在一起，因此我们框架梯度优势) shows the collapse is co-mingled with generic distributional drift, so we frame gradient dominance(Yu et al., 2020)并作为竞争假设而漂移。其次，每个域的覆盖范围与准确性非单调相关，形成倒 U 形曲线，拟合峰值接近中等份额：类似于适度的混合水平关联，而不是确定的剂量反应定律。and drift as competing hypotheses. Second, per-domain coverage is non-monotonically associated with accuracy, forming inverted-U curves with fitted peaks near moderate shares: a moderation-like mixture-level association, not an identified dose-response law.

这些模式仅限于经过测试的 KOR-Bench/Qwen3-8B-Base 设置，扩展These patterns are confined to the tested KOR-Bench/Qwen3-8B-Base setting, extendingZhang et al. (2025).

什么会反驳标题的主张。What would disconfirm the headline claim.

三个观察结果中的两个在构造上是脆弱的：“倒U”和“干扰”依赖于单纯形约束下的仅中间训练检查点（§Two of the three observations are fragile by construction: the “inverted-U” and the “interference” rest on mid-training-only checkpoints under a simplex constraint (§5.2–5.3）。单个实验可能推翻的观察结果是). The observation a single experiment could disconfirm is the结构性负面结果structural negative result（观察 1）：如果固定预算补偿性 SFT 通过对覆盖范围不足的域进行重新加权，则可以完全缩小域间差距（在(Observation 1): if a fixed-budget compensatory-SFT pass reweighting toward coverage-deficient domains fully closed the between-domain gaps (closure approaching 100% under the55pp 公制而不是 0/240），我们的主张将被反驳。pp metric rather than 0/240), our claim would be refuted.

5.1 为什么测试的对准通过后没有缩小差距Why the Tested Alignment Passes Did Not Close the Gaps

这些观察结果与多种解释相一致：预算竞争、特定领域的多样性、优化不匹配、有限的训练后探索以及补偿公式的算术上限（These observations are compatible with several explanations: budget competition, domain-specific diversity, optimization mismatch, limited post-training exploration, and the arithmetic cap of the compensation formula (≈7\approx 7PP 建筑；附录pp by construction; AppendixG）。能力包络账户仍然是一个假设：这项研究不测量表征、梯度冲突或参数重叠。). A capability-envelope account remains a hypothesis: this study does not measure representations, gradient conflict, or parameter overlap.

5.2 单纯形混淆The Simplex Confound

这种设计的结构限制值得明确处理。覆盖范围是零和分配：五个域比例之和始终为A structural limit of this design deserves explicit treatment. Coverage is a zero-sum allocation: the five domain proportions always sum to100%100\%，因此一个域的份额不能独立于其他四个域而变化，并且一个不变的外部语料库（, so a domain’s share cannot be varied independently of the other four, and an unvarying external corpus (34.8%34.8\%ProofWriter）贡献的共享曝光在运行过程中保持不变。因此，每条每域曲线都是ProofWriter) contributes shared exposure held constant across runs. Consequently, each per-domain curve is a混合水平边际mixture-level marginal而不是每个域的剂量响应，并且域显示的倒U形“峰值”是单纯形与固定外部组件平衡的属性，而不是该域覆盖范围的孤立属性：“覆盖范围”不是一个完全可操纵的剂量。分离它们需要一个单纯形感知的联合响应面模型，我们运行了该模型（附录rather than a per-domain dose-response, and the inverted-U “peak” a domain shows is a property of where the simplex balances against the fixed external component, not an isolated property of that domain’s coverage: “coverage” is not a cleanly manipulable dose. Separating them requires a simplex-aware joint response-surface model, which we ran (AppendixF.2, B.2)：将分配映射到等距对数比坐标并拟合每个域的二次曲面拟合效果很好，但驻点读取为): mapping allocations to isometric log-ratio coordinates and fitting a per-domain quadratic surface fits well, but the stationary point reads as a马鞍saddle在每个域中，并且在 42 个分配池（30 个基础加上 12 个内部分配）中保持 1 个。我们强调这种分类是临时的——从 42 个分配中估计出 15 个二次项，Hessian 的确定性太弱，无法将鞍座与浅平坦区域分开（附录in every domain, and remains one over the 42-allocation pool (30 base plus the 12 interior allocations). We stress this classification is provisional—with 15 quadratic terms estimated from 42 allocations the Hessian is too weakly determined to separate a saddle from a shallow flat region (AppendixF.2）——因此内部数据既不建立共同最优的混合，也不排除浅的混合。因此，观察 3 的五个每域最优值是边际陈述，而不是一个联合最优混合物的坐标。)—so the interior data neither establish a jointly optimal mixture nor exclude a shallow one. The five per-domain optima of Observation 3 are therefore marginal statements, not the coordinates of one jointly optimal mixture.

5.3 控制混乱：对不相关数据的中期训练也会降低范围外推理能力A Control Confound: Mid-Training on Unrelated Data Also Degrades Out-of-Scope Reasoning

干扰解释依赖于“让 KOR-Bench 域挨饿”才是对其造成伤害的说法。 FineWeb-Edu 专用控件（表The interference interpretation relies on the claim that “starving a KOR-Bench domain” is what hurts it. The FineWeb-Edu-only control (Table13）挑战这一框架：仅在 FineWeb-Edu 上进行中期训练——) challenges this framing: mid-training on FineWeb-Edu alone—noKOR-Bench 数据——反事实从之前的 83.6% 下降到 29.2%（KOR-Bench data at all—drops Counterfactual from its Base prior of 83.6% to 29.2% (−54.4-54.4页），一个pp), a更大larger低于零 KOR 覆盖率 Expt。 1 例（drop than the zero-KOR-coverage Expt. 1 case (−38.0-38.0pp)，并将运行率从 60.4% 降至 45.6%（pp), and drops Operation from 60.4% to 45.6% (−14.8-14.8页）。因此，扫描归因于选择性地饥饿 KOR-Bench 域的干扰与更广泛的影响混合在一起：任何持续的预训练，包括与基准完全无关的文本，都会降低范围外的推理能力。我们将干扰发现视为内部观察。pp). The interference the sweep attributes to selectively starving a KOR-Bench domain is thus co-mingled with a broader effect: any continued pre-training, including on text wholly unrelated to the benchmark, degrades out-of-scope reasoning. We frame the interference finding as a within-setting observation.

5.4 对设计的影响Implications for Design

因为单纯形混淆尚未解决，并且没有保留的分配来验证拟合的峰值、区间或Because the simplex confound is unresolved and no held-out allocation validates the fitted peaks, intervals, orθ∗\theta^{*}，这些结果支持一个要测试的假设，而不是一个要遵循的规则：它们没有建立一个域应该保持“适度”，也没有建立以后的对齐通常不能纠正覆盖选择。, these results support a hypothesis to test rather than a rule to follow: they do not establish that a domain should be kept “in moderation,” nor that later alignment generally cannot correct coverage choices.

6 结论Conclusion

在这种情况下，三个发现成立。首先，覆盖引起的域差距在我们测试的有限预算后训练程序中幸存下来：补偿政策和等预算统一控制都使差距基本完好无损（0/240桥接对在Three findings hold in this setting. First, coverage-induced domain gaps survive the finite-budget post-training procedures we tested: the compensatory policy and an equal-budget uniform control both leave the gaps essentially intact (0/240 bridged pairs under the55pp 指标），这概括为六个保留的分配和一个排列空（pp metric), this generalizes to six held-out allocations, and a permutation null (P<0.001P<0.001;附录; AppendixG.2）表明收益是以保留差距的方式分配的：预算安排，不仅是其规模，也保留了差距。其次，零中期训练覆盖率会破坏仅中期训练的准确性，即使先验较高，但测试的配方逆转了这些崩溃的迹象（表) shows the gains are placed in a gap-preserving way: budget placement, not only its size, preserves the gaps. Second, zero mid-training coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy even with a high prior, but the tested recipe reverses the sign of these collapses (Table6），在 Logic 和 Puzzle 上留下了小的残留赤字，而仅 FineWeb-Edu 的控件表明这与通用分布漂移混合在一起。第三，每个域都有一个内部覆盖最佳值：对于所有五个域，中等频段比低频段或高频段产生更高的平均精度，不涉及曲线拟合（附录), leaving a small residual deficit on Logic and Puzzle, and the FineWeb-Edu-only control shows this is co-mingled with generic distributional drift. Third, every domain has an interior coverage optimum: the moderate band yields higher mean accuracy than the low or high band for all five domains, with no curve fitting involved (AppendixF.1），拟合的峰值位于), and the fitted peaks lie between9.9%9.9\%和and35.1%35.1\%。这些最优值是每个域的边缘，而不是共同可实现的混合：即使在添加了 12 个内部分配之后，组合响应面的驻点在每个域中都被视为鞍座（附录. These optima are per-domain marginals, not a jointly achievable mixture: the compositional response surface’s stationary point reads as a saddle in every domain, even after 12 interior allocations are added (AppendixF.2, B.2），这种分类是临时性的而非决定性的，并且因果归因仍然遥不可及。实际意义是有条件的：覆盖范围分配可能需要明确的审计，但是), a classification that is provisional rather than decisive—and causal attribution remains out of reach. The practical implication is conditional: coverage allocation may warrant explicit auditing, but theθ∗\theta^{*}增益（gain (+4.36+4.36pp) 在未经校正的韦尔奇测试下处于边缘状态，并且仍然是同一扫描中模型选择的候选者（范围和限制：附录pp) is marginal under an uncorrected Welch test and remains a model-selected candidate from the same sweep (scope and limits: AppendixI).

A.1 LLM推理的多阶段培训Multi-Stage Training for LLM Reasoning

现代推理模型通常通过一系列持续预训练、SFT 和 RL 进行训练。基本的人类反馈强化学习 (RLHF) 框架Modern reasoning models are typically trained through a sequence of continued pretraining, SFT, and RL. The foundational Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) framework(Ouyang et al., 2022)建立了标准的三阶段方案：预训练、演示监督微调和 RLHF，大多数后续系统都采用该方案。established the standard three-stage recipe of pretraining, supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations, and RLHF, which most subsequent systems adopt.Guo et al. (2025)表明 RL 在应用于有能力的基础模型时可以引发强大的推理行为，而其完整的 DeepSeek-R1 流程仍然依赖于冷启动 SFT 和额外的监督数据。show that RL can elicit strong reasoning behavior when applied to a capable base model, while their full DeepSeek-R1 pipeline still relies on cold-start SFT and additional supervised data.Shao et al. (2024)证明特定领域的持续预训练可以在后期训练之前显着提高数学推理能力。 Kimi k1.5 在多阶段环境中进一步扩展强化学习demonstrate that domain-specific continued pretraining can substantially improve mathematical reasoning before later post-training. Kimi k1.5 further scales reinforcement learning in a multi-stage setting(Team KIMI, 2025)。这些工作确立了分阶段训练的有效性，但它们通常报告总体基准分数，并且没有隔离训练中期数据不平衡如何影响领域级结果。. These works establish the effectiveness of stage-wise training, but they usually report aggregate benchmark scores and do not isolate how mid-training data imbalance shapes domain-level outcomes.

更广泛的模型报告还强调了训练阶段和数据覆盖范围的重要性。 Llama 3 强调大规模训练前和训练后食谱的作用Broader model reports also reinforce the importance of training stages and data coverages. Llama 3 emphasizes the role of large-scale pretraining and post-training recipes(Dubey et al., 2024)。实习生LM2. InternLM2(Cai et al., 2024)明确地将渐进式训练策略与精心策划的训练中期数据相结合以进行推理，使域分配成为一流的工程问题。 Phi-4 强调了高质量合成和整理数据对于面向推理的模型的重要性explicitly incorporates a progressive training strategy with carefully curated mid-training data for reasoning, making domain allocation a first-class engineering concern. Phi-4 highlights the importance of high-quality synthetic and curated data for reasoning-oriented models(Abdin et al., 2024)。我们的工作与这些系统报告不同，我们将训练中期数据组合本身作为研究对象。. Our work differs from these system reports by treating mid-training data composition itself as the object of study.

A.2 中期训练的作用The Role of Mid-Training

培训中期越来越被认为是一个有自己的目标和失败模式的阶段。Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a stage with its own objectives and failure modes.Tu et al. (2025)调查最近的工作并将中期培训框架作为广泛的预培训和下游协调之间的桥梁。survey recent work and frame mid-training as a bridge between broad pretraining and downstream alignment.Zhang et al. (2025)提供受控证据，证明早期的训练暴露决定了 RL 后期的泛化能力。他们的发现激发了我们的核心问题，但他们的背景是故意控制和合成的。相反，我们检查自然不平衡的多领域语料库。provide controlled evidence that earlier training exposure determines how much later RL can generalize. Their finding motivates our central question, but their setting is deliberately controlled and synthetic. We instead examine a naturally imbalanced multi-domain corpus.

多项研究表明，持续的预训练可以注入有用的推理结构。Several studies suggest that continued pretraining can inject useful reasoning structure.Ruis et al. (2024)认为预训练数据中的程序知识可以驱动推理性能。argue that procedural knowledge in pretraining data drives reasoning performance.Ishibashi et al. (2025)研究使用合成数据进行持续预训练以进行推理。study continual pretraining with synthetic data for reasoning.Yu et al. (2023)表明引导数学数据可以提高数学推理能力。在相关方向上，show that bootstrapped mathematical data can improve math reasoning. In a related direction,Lu et al. (2024)使用模型翻译的数学代码进行持续的预训练。这种方法最清晰的单域范例是 Llemmause model-translated mathematical code for continued pretraining. The clearest single-domain exemplar of this approach is Llemma(Azerbayev et al., 2024)，继续在 55B 代币 Proof-Pile-2 语料库上对 Code Llama 进行预训练，并在数学基准上取得了实质性进展；这项工作表明，针对特定领域的推理语料库的持续预训练是实现能力专业化的可靠途径。我们的工作将这条线扩展到多域设置，其中跨域分配是主要的规划坐标。由此产生的覆盖敏感模式是探索性的，在目前的单纯形设计下，不能被解释为独立识别的特定领域剂量反应效应。, which continues pretraining Code Llama on the 55B-token Proof-Pile-2 corpus and achieves substantial gains on mathematical benchmarks; this work establishes that domain-specific continued pretraining on curated reasoning corpora is a reliable path to capability specialization. Our work extends this line to a multi-domain setting where allocation across domains is the primary planned coordinate. The resulting coverage-sensitive patterns are exploratory and cannot, under the present simplex design, be interpreted as an independently identified domain-specific dose-response effect.

剂量反应效应的超覆盖一半可能与多任务优化中的干扰有关The over-coverage half of the dose-response effect may be related to interference in multi-task optimisation(French, 1999; Kirkpatrick et al., 2017; Yu et al., 2020)。在顺序连续学习中，对新任务进行集中训练会导致梯度更新覆盖编码先前学习任务的参数区域，这种现象称为灾难性遗忘. In sequential continual learning, training intensively on a new task causes gradient updates to overwrite the parameter regions encoding previously learned tasks—a phenomenon termed catastrophic forgetting(French, 1999; Luo et al., 2023a)。持续预训练的扩展和数据管理策略已被研究作为缓解杠杆. Scaling and data-curation strategies for continual pre-training have been studied as mitigation levers(Ibrahim et al., 2024)，但它们解决的是顺序适应而不是同时任务域之间的分配。我们的设置在结构上有所不同：所有领域都是同时训练而不是顺序训练。然而，不平衡的覆盖可能会产生类似的梯度主导效应：高覆盖域贡献了大部分梯度信号，将共享表示推向其目标，并减少来自低覆盖域的信号。我们不直接测量梯度冲突、参数重叠或弹性权重合并（EWC）式的缓解措施，因此这种解释应该被理解为一种假设，而不是一种论证的机制。, but they address sequential adaptation rather than allocation among simultaneous task domains. Our setting differs structurally: all domains are trained simultaneously rather than sequentially. However, imbalanced coverage may produce an analogous gradient-dominance effect: the high-coverage domain contributes the majority of the gradient signal, pushing shared representations toward its objectives and reducing the signal from low-coverage domains. We do not directly measure gradient conflict, parameter overlap, or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC)-style mitigation, so this explanation should be read as a hypothesis rather than a demonstrated mechanism.

KOR-Bench 域有The KOR-Bench domains have语义规则不相交semantic rule-disjointness：每个域都定义了一个独立的符号系统，其规则不依赖于其他域的概念或操作。这减少了语义转移混淆的一个来源，但它并没有使域在统计或神经意义上独立。域仍然共享语言、标记化、输出格式、模型参数和潜在的通用推理过程。因此，我们将比例视为受控混合物坐标，而不是独立的因果剂量。目前的设计没有单独识别独特示例多样性、重复、序列长度或所有外部语料库暴露的覆盖范围。: each domain defines a self-contained symbolic system whose rules do not rely on concepts or operations from other domains. This reduces one source of semantic-transfer confounding, but it does not make domains independent in the statistical or neural sense. Domains still share language, tokenization, output formats, model parameters, and potentially general reasoning procedures. We therefore treat the proportions as a controlled mixture coordinate, not as an independent causal dose. The present design does not separately identify coverage from unique-example diversity, repetition, sequence length, or all external-corpus exposure.

训练中期数据的质量和格式与数量一样重要。The quality and format of mid-training data matter as much as the quantity.Wei et al. (2022)证明思想链推理轨迹（作为训练信号提供的逐步解释）可显着改善大型模型中的多步推理；我们的管道在每个生成的实例中嵌入类似的结构化跟踪。demonstrate that chain-of-thought reasoning traces—step-by-step explanations provided as training signal—substantially improve multi-step reasoning in large models; our pipeline embeds analogous structured traces in every generated instance.Luo et al. (2023b)研究表明，应用于数学种子问题的指令进化（Evol-Instruct）会产生越来越难的变体，从而提高微调模型的性能，证明数据质量放大可以替代原始体积。show that instruction evolution (Evol-Instruct) applied to mathematical seed problems produces progressively harder variants that boost fine-tuned model performance, demonstrating that data quality amplification can substitute for raw volume.Toshniwal et al. (2024)使用 OpenMathInstruct-1 扩展此方法，这是一个由 Mixtral-8x7B 合成的针对 MATH 基准的 180 万个问题语料库scale this approach with OpenMathInstruct-1, a 1.8M-problem corpus synthesized by Mixtral-8x7B targeting the MATH benchmark(Hendrycks et al., 2021)，它已成为数学推理能力的规范衡量标准。这些研究共同表明，结构化、经过验证、跟踪注释的问题是中期训练有效性的基本货币——我们的多领域研究将这一原则扩展到五种异构推理类型。, which has become a canonical measure of mathematical reasoning capability. These studies collectively show that structured, verified, trace-annotated problems are the fundamental currency of mid-training effectiveness—a principle our multi-domain study extends to five heterogeneous reasoning types.

数据组合是另一个重要的线索。Data composition is another important thread.Yang et al. (2024)分析预训练选择如何影响下游能力。analyze how pretraining choices affect downstream capabilities.Qin et al. (2026)认为预训练建立了后期阶段可能不易超过的能力上限。小米的 MiMo 报告还强调通过精心设计的训练数据释放推理潜力argue that pretraining establishes capability ceilings that later stages may not easily exceed. Xiaomi’s MiMo report also emphasizes unlocking reasoning potential through carefully designed training data(Xiaomi LLM-Core, 2025)。我们的研究增加了领域层面的观点：问题不仅在于中期培训是否对整体有帮助，还在于哪些领域受益，哪些领域落后。. Our study adds a domain-level view: the question is not only whether mid-training helps overall, but which domains benefit and which domains are left behind.

A.3 数据混合和覆盖优化Data Mixture and Coverage Optimization

如何跨域分配数据的问题在预训练文献中得到了充分研究。The question of how to allocate data across domains is well-studied in the pretraining literature.Gururangan et al. (2020)确定即使是适度的特定领域数据的领域自适应持续预训练也能显着提高下游任务性能，并且收益会随着通用网络预训练分布与目标领域之间的不匹配而扩大。establish that domain-adaptive continued pretraining on even modest domain-specific data substantially improves downstream task performance, and that the benefit scales with the mismatch between the general-web pretraining distribution and the target domain.Xie et al. (2023a)提出DoReMi，一种基于组分布鲁棒优化（DRO）的方法，动态重新加权域贡献以均衡每个域的过度损失；他们的框架直接解决了我们的扫描凭经验操作的均匀与非均匀加权问题。propose DoReMi, a Group Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO)-based method that dynamically reweights domain contributions to equalize per-domain excess loss; their framework directly addresses the uniform-vs.-non-uniform weighting question that our sweep operationalizes empirically.Fan et al. (2024)使用 DoGE 扩展这条线，DoGE 通过小型代理模型根据域对泛化目标的估计贡献来重新加权； DoGE 和我们的extend this line with DoGE, which reweights domains by their estimated contribution to a generalization objective via a small proxy model; DoGE and ourθ∗\theta^{*}两者都产生单个推荐分配，但方向相反——DoGE 优化基于梯度的泛化估计，而无需在目标分配上进行训练，而both produce a single recommended allocation, but from opposite directions—DoGE optimizes a gradient-based generalization estimate without training at the target allocation, whereasθ∗\theta^{*}读取测量的每域精度曲线。对同一五域语料库进行受控比较将提供丰富的信息，此处不进行尝试。is read off measured per-domain accuracy curves. A controlled comparison on the same five-domain corpus would be informative and is not attempted here.

在语料库层面，Pile 中的大规模成分消融At the corpus level, large-scale composition ablations in the Pile(Gao et al., 2021)和卓玛and Dolma(Soldaini et al., 2024)证明数据源组合是基准性能的最强预测因素之一。补充工作地址demonstrate that data-source mix is among the strongest predictors of benchmark performance. Complementary work addresses其中which要包含的数据而不是如何对每个域进行加权。data to include rather than how to weight each domain.Xie et al. (2023b)提出通过重要性重采样（DSIR）进行数据选择，选择 n-gram 分布与目标域匹配的预训练文档，有效地实现没有硬语料库边界的软域过滤。propose Data Selection via Importance Resampling (DSIR), selecting pretraining documents whose n-gram distributions match a target domain, effectively enabling soft domain filtering without hard corpus boundaries.Shen et al. (2023)通过重新平衡和删除 RedPajama 语料库来构建 SlimPajama-DC，表明语料库级别的域重新平衡会产生一致的下游改进。construct SlimPajama-DC by rebalancing and deduplicating the RedPajama corpus, showing that domain rebalancing at the corpus level yields consistent downstream improvements.Muennighoff et al. (2023)检查数据重复的补充问题：当领域语料库很小时，多个时期的训练可以部分替代额外的数据，尽管回报递减；在解释我们的低覆盖率配置时，这个界限是相关的。随后出现了更细粒度的理论处理：examine the complementary question of data repetition: when a domain corpus is small, training for multiple epochs can partially substitute for additional data, though with diminishing returns; this bound is relevant when interpreting our low-coverage configurations. More fine-grained theoretical treatments have followed:Ye et al. (2025)建立定量缩放定律，预测语言建模损失作为域混合比例的函数，以及establish quantitative scaling laws that predict language modeling loss as a function of domain mixture proportions, andLiu et al. (2025)提出 RegMix，它在不同的领域组合中训练 512 个小型代理模型，并拟合回归预测器来识别最佳的大规模混合——这是对我们的经验扫描的原则性补充。两种方法都针对总体困惑度进行优化；我们的贡献是对有限预算混合物配置如何与此受控设置中的下游精度相关联的领域解析诊断，而不是一般的剂量反应定律。更新的混合优化方法，例如 MergeMixpropose RegMix, which trains 512 small proxy models across diverse domain combinations and fits a regression predictor to identify the optimal large-scale mixture—a principled complement to our empirical sweep. Both methods optimize for aggregate perplexity; our contribution is a domain-resolved diagnostic of how finite-budget mixture configurations are associated with downstream accuracy in this controlled setting, not a general dose-response law. More recent mixture-optimization methods such as MergeMix(Wang et al., 2026)建议使用模型合并权重作为域性能的低成本代理——一种不同的优化策略。未来的工作是在当前的五域设置中对这些方法进行受控比较；当前的扫描并未验证他们建议的分配或当地的中等频段指导。propose using model merging weights as a low-cost proxy for domain performance—a different optimization strategy. A controlled comparison of these methods in the present five-domain setup is future work; the current sweep does not validate their recommended allocations or the local moderate-band guidance.

A.4 SFT和RL：阶段组合和细化SFT and RL: Stage Combination and Refinement

SFT 和 RL 通常被视为调整和细化的机制，而不是全新功能的来源。SFT and RL are often treated as mechanisms for alignment and refinement rather than as sources of entirely new capabilities.Havrilla et al. (2024)观察到强化学习可能很难探索远远超出监督模型已经达到的解决方案。observe that RL can struggle to explore far beyond solutions already reachable by the supervised model.Chen et al. (2024b)表明自我对弈微调可以改进弱模型，但也可以在不不断扩展数据分布的情况下收敛。这些发现与后期阶段继承早期阶段的约束的观点是一致的。show that self-play fine-tuning can improve weak models but also converges without continually expanding the data distribution. These findings are consistent with the idea that later stages inherit constraints from earlier stages.

最近的工作进一步研究了如何将 SFT 和 RL 结合起来。Recent work further studies how SFT and RL should be combined.Wang et al. (2025)比较强化学习和监督训练在指令遵循方面的差异。compare reinforcement learning and supervised training in instruction following.Chen et al. (2025)提出 SFT 和 RL 的逐步自适应集成。propose step-wise adaptive integration of SFT and RL.Deng et al. (2025)将专家轨迹与逐步强化学习联系起来。connect expert trajectories with step-wise reinforcement learning.Ren et al. (2026)重新审视 SFT 推理中的泛化，同时revisit generalization in reasoning SFT, whileMatsutani (2025)对比 SFT 和 RL 对推理模型的影响。两个基本贡献限制了预训练阶段的有效性。利马contrasts the effects of SFT and RL on reasoning models. Two foundational contributions bound the effectiveness of post-pretraining stages. LIMA(Zhou et al., 2023)表明，只要 1,000 个精心策划的演示就可以在指令遵循质量方面与更大的 SFT 语料库相匹配，这意味着早期训练阶段预先建立的能力空间是主要瓶颈，而不是微调数量。直接偏好优化 (DPO)demonstrates that as few as 1,000 carefully curated demonstrations can match much larger SFT corpora in instruction-following quality, implying that the capability headroom pre-established by earlier training stages is the primary bottleneck rather than fine-tuning volume. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)(Rafailov et al., 2023)将偏好调整重新表述为对比监督学习，删除奖励模型并大幅降低 RL 阶段的工程复杂性； DPO 的广泛采用使得像我们这样的受控早期消融术更容易复制。我们的实验解决了这个问题的两个方向。首先，后期阶段不能可靠地补偿训练中期引入的域不平衡：即使当 SFT 数据向覆盖不足的域增强时，基于差异的成对间隙也无法缩小到超出reformulates preference alignment as contrastive supervised learning, removing the reward model and substantially lowering the engineering complexity of the RL stage; the wider adoption of DPO has made controlled earlier-stage ablations such as ours easier to reproduce. Our experiments address both directions of this question. First, later stages do not reliably compensate for domain imbalance introduced at mid-training: even when SFT data is augmented toward coverage-deficient domains, difference-based pairwise gaps fail to close beyond the55pp 修复阈值（0/240 对下pp repair threshold (0/240 pairs under a55pp 差异指标），基于比率的差距仅显示有限的平均闭合度（30/240 对pp difference metric), and ratio-based gaps show only limited average closure (30/240 pairs under a10%10\%比）。等预算统一 SFT 控制的行为几乎相同（相同指标下的 0/240 和 32/240；附录ratio). An equal-budget uniform-SFT control behaves almost identically (0/240 and 32/240 under the same metrics; AppendixG），因此非闭包不是补偿公式的产物。每个域的增益与补救分配的拟合（), so the non-closure is not an artifact of the compensation formula. Per-domain fits of the gain against the remedial allocation (Δ≈a​log⁡(1+b​r)+c\Delta\approx a\log(1+b\,r)+c）在每个域内上升，但在特定域的上限处饱和，并且跨域的池化几乎不能解释单元级方差（) rise within each domain yet saturate at domain-specific ceilings, and pooling across domains explains little of the cell-level variance (R2≈0.31R^{2}\approx 0.31;图; Figure7, 表, Table16)：重定向 SFT 数据不会重置中间训练起点。其次，当覆盖范围将大多数域置于其拟合的 95% 峰值区间内时，优化训练中期覆盖范围会使后期阶段变得更加有效：训练中期增加): redirecting SFT data does not reset the mid-training starting point. Second, optimizing mid-training coverage makes later stages materially more effective when coverage places most domains within their fitted 95%-of-peak intervals: mid-training adds+4.36+4.36pp 超过 Expt 中的无中间训练 SFT+RL。 3（带内五个域中的四个，操作正好低于下边界），与pp over no-mid-training SFT+RL in Expt. 3 (four of five domains in-band, Operation just below the lower boundary), compared with+0.8+0.8pp 处于平衡覆盖范围内，并且pp under balanced coverage and+0.6+0.6pp 覆盖不平衡。pp under imbalanced coverage.

A.5 推理评估和领域级分析Reasoning Evaluation and Domain-Level Analysis

推理能力通常以单个汇总数字的形式报告，但汇总分数可能会掩盖收益和损失发生的地方。两个广泛使用的基准测试说明了这种屏蔽问题： GSM8KReasoning ability is often reported as a single aggregate number, but aggregate scores can obscure where gains and losses occur. Two widely used benchmarks illustrate this masking problem: GSM8K(Cobbe et al., 2021)将小学算术推理减少到一次 pass@1 准确率数字，而 BIG-Bench Hardreduces grade-school arithmetic reasoning to a single pass@1 accuracy number, while BIG-Bench Hard(Suzgun et al., 2023)将 23 个不同的任务（涵盖归纳、演绎、空间和算法推理）聚合为一个分数，该分数可以隐藏我们的领域级分析所揭示的每个领域的不同趋势。aggregates 23 diverse tasks—spanning inductive, deductive, spatial, and algorithmic reasoning—into a single score that can conceal divergent per-domain trends of the kind our domain-level analysis reveals.Ke et al. (2025)广泛调查推理基准，并强调用于评估法学硕士推理的任务的多样性。先前关于代码和推理的工作也将广泛的能力分解为更小的行为单元，例如在代码模型函数的分析中survey reasoning benchmarks broadly and emphasize the diversity of tasks used to evaluate LLM reasoning. Prior work on code and reasoning also decomposes broad competence into smaller behavioral units, for example in analyses of code-model functions(Chen et al., 2024a)和参数高效推理模块and parameter-efficient reasoning modules(Huang et al., 2025). Huang et al. (2026)进一步使用 RL 信号来指导训练中期数据选择。我们都有超越单一全局分数的动机，但我们的分析是围绕领域级中间训练覆盖范围和下游领域级行为进行组织的。further use RL signals to guide mid-training data selection. We share the motivation of looking beyond a single global score, but our analysis is organized around domain-level mid-training coverage and downstream domain-level behavior.

A.6 知识正交和结构化推理基准Knowledge-Orthogonal and Structured Reasoning Benchmarks

评估需要应用明确规则而不是检索记忆的世界知识的结构化推理任务的法学硕士已引起越来越多的关注。Evaluating LLMs on structured reasoning tasks that require applying explicit rules rather than retrieving memorized world knowledge has gained increasing attention.Han et al. (2024)引入 FOLIO，一个一阶逻辑推理数据集，其中模型必须从形式逻辑语句中推导出蕴涵，而不依赖于表面层启发法；前沿模型的困难激发了我们在逻辑领域进行的中期训练覆盖率研究。introduce FOLIO, a first-order logic reasoning dataset in which models must derive entailment from formal logical statements without relying on surface-level heuristics; its difficulty for frontier models motivates the mid-training coverage study we conduct on the Logic domain.Liu et al. (2020)推出 LogiQA，这是一个取自中国公务员考试的多项选择逻辑推理基准，涵盖分类推理、条件推理和选言推理类型；其结构多样性代表了我们研究的遵守规则的挑战。present LogiQA, a multiple-choice logical reasoning benchmark drawn from Chinese civil-service examinations covering categorical, conditional, and disjunctive reasoning types; its structural diversity is representative of the rule-following challenge we study.Sinha et al. (2019)构建 CLUTRR，通过从训练分布中保留链长组合来测试关系规则遵循的系统泛化——这是与我们的逻辑和谜题领域的形式演绎结构密切相关的组合泛化挑战。最近，construct CLUTRR to test systematic generalization in relational rule-following by withholding chain-length compositions from the training distribution—a compositional generalization challenge closely related to the formal-deduction structure of our Logic and Puzzle domains. More recently,Zhou et al. (2025)提出 RuleArena，评估复杂现实世界规则系统（航空公司政策、税法、NBA 法规）的模型，要求遵守与 KOR-Bench 相同的规则propose RuleArena, evaluating models on complex real-world rule systems (airline policies, tax codes, NBA regulations), requiring the same kind of rule-adherence that KOR-Bench(Ma et al., 2025)形式化为知识正交推理。销货成本formalizes as knowledge-orthogonal reasoning. COGS(Kim and Linzen, 2020)通过构建其结构复杂性系统地超过训练分布的测试用例来探索语义解析中的组合泛化；它揭示了组合差距——模型在它们单独处理的原语组合上失败——与 KOR-Bench 的规则组合设计相似，并促使人们强调泛化而不是记忆。 AI2 推理挑战赛 (ARC)probes compositional generalization in semantic parsing by constructing test cases whose structural complexity systematically exceeds the training distribution; the compositional gap it reveals—where models fail on combinations of primitives they handle individually—parallels KOR-Bench’s rule-composition design and motivates the emphasis on generalization over memorization. The AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)(Clark et al., 2018)将基本科学问题分为可检索解决的简单集和需要推理的挑战集，提供了一个早期证明，即即使是适度的推理也需要以聚合精度无法捕获的方式对模型进行分层。partitions elementary science questions into a retrieval-solvable Easy set and an inference-requiring Challenge set, providing an early demonstration that even modest reasoning demands stratify models in ways aggregate accuracy cannot capture.

我们的工作与这些基准贡献的不同之处在于它侧重于Our work differs from these benchmark contributions in its focus on the训练方training side：我们不是提出新的评估标准，而是问训练中期特定领域数据的比例如何决定是否可靠地获得相应的结构化推理能力。 KOR-Bench 的知识正交特性确保一个领域的训练收益不会自动转移到其他领域，使其成为一种特别受控的工具，用于隔离每个领域覆盖的影响。: rather than proposing new evaluation criteria, we ask how the proportion of domain-specific data during mid-training determines whether the corresponding structured reasoning capabilities are reliably acquired. The knowledge-orthogonal property of KOR-Bench—which ensures that training gains in one domain do not automatically transfer to others—makes it a particularly controlled instrument for isolating the effect of per-domain coverage.

C.6 RL 预算：解释限制和训练不稳定RL Budget: Interpretive Limitations and Training Instability

在所有三个实验中观察到的小 RL 增益（The small RL gains observed across all three experiments (+1.1+1.1–+2.3+2.3来自 GSPO 的 pp；最大的，pp from GSPO; the largest,+2.30+2.30pp，发生在探索性的pp, occurs under the exploratoryθ∗\theta^{*}分配）提出了更大的 RL 预算是否会改变补偿性结论的问题。 两种解释与数据一致。allocation) raise the question of whether a larger RL budget would alter the compensatory conclusion. Two interpretations are consistent with the data.解释 1——能力有限的强化学习。Interpretation 1 — Competence-limited RL.200 步的 GSPO 阶段可能确实受到模型当前能力的限制：基于验证者的强化学习强化了现有的链，而不是发现新的符号过程，因此，无论预算如何，训练中期表现较弱的领域都获得很少的强化学习增益。The 200-step GSPO stage may be genuinely limited by the model’s current competence: verifier-based RL reinforces existing chains rather than discovering new symbolic procedures, so domains that mid-training left weak receive little RL gain regardless of budget.解释 2 — RL 预算不足。Interpretation 2 — Insufficient RL budget.200 个步骤可能不足以体现 RL 的纠正潜力；原则上，较长的时间表可以通过为模型提供更多探索机会以及让验证者在弱域中发现正确但概率较低的链来重塑域差距。 我们无法将这些解释与我们的实验区分开来，并且我们将 RL 腿视为次要观察而不是标题声明，原因有两个。首先，奖励是一个二进制正确性验证器，因此无法从思想链中提取密集的每个代币奖励信号；强化学习只能强化整体答案结果。其次，延长 GSPO 预算在实践中并不是一个完全可调的旋钮：较长的时间表在种子之间不稳定（奖励分歧，没有一致的方向趋势），而不是简单地成熟为稳定的、绩效较高的政策。本文中出现了两种不同的强化学习设置，我们将它们明确分开。 (i) Table 的三种全管道配置200 steps may simply be insufficient to manifest RL’s corrective potential; a longer schedule could in principle reshape the domain gaps by giving the model more opportunities to explore and for the verifier to surface correct but low-probability chains in weak domains. We cannot distinguish these interpretations from our experiments, and we treat the RL leg as a secondary observation rather than a headline claim for two reasons. First, the reward is a binary correctness verifier, so no dense per-token reward signal can be extracted from the chain-of-thought; RL can only reinforce whole-answer outcomes. Second, extending the GSPO budget is not a cleanly tunable knob in practice: longer schedules were unstable across seeds (reward divergence without a consistent directional trend) rather than simply maturing into a stable higher-performing policy. Two distinct RL settings appear in this paper and we separate them explicitly. (i) The three full-pipeline configurations of Table1使用标准管道（训练中期use the standard pipeline (mid-training→\rightarrow规则类型平衡SFTrule-type-balanced SFT→\rightarrowRL）。 (ii) 六项保留的分配在培训中期进行RL). (ii) The six held-out allocations are carried through mid-training→\rightarrow 补偿性的compensatory快速傅里叶变换SFT→\rightarrowRL，正是这些运行产生了RL, and it is these runs that produce the强化学习评估RL Evaluation表的行数rows of Table13以及§中报告的样本外结果and the out-of-sample results reported in §4.1（意思是(mean+1.19+1.19pp 超过补偿通行证；pp over the compensatory pass;0/600/60对关闭于pairs closed at the55pp 阈值和pp threshold and7/607/60在at the10%10\%完整管道后的比率）。在补偿性 SFT 后添加 RL 的早期探索性尝试ratio after the complete pipeline). Early exploratory attempts to add RL after compensatory SFT24 种扫描配置on the 24 sweep configurations显示出跨种子不稳定性，并根据其他地方使用的相同标准被排除在报告的扫描结果之外（奖励分歧或 200 步预算内没有一致的方向趋势）；该排除仅适用于那些扫描运行，不适用于六个保留的分配，其 RL 运行已完整报告。因此，补偿性 SFT 加 RL 时间表是否会缩小整个 24 个配置扫描中的差距仍然悬而未决，而在 6 个保留的分配上，它显然不会。我们将 RL 阶段的范围限定为经过测试的 200 步计划，并且不会将其微小的增益视为一般训练后修复的证据。图showed cross-seed instability and are excluded from the reported sweep results, under the same criterion used elsewhere (reward divergence or no consistent directional trend within the 200-step budget); that exclusion applies to those sweep runs only and not to the six held-out allocations, whose RL runs are reported in full. Whether a compensatory-SFT-plus-RL schedule would close gaps across the whole 24-configuration sweep therefore remains open, while on the six held-out allocations it demonstrably does not. We scope the RL stage to the tested 200-step schedule and do not read its small gains as evidence about post-training repair in general. C.7 代码和数据可用性Code and Data Availability

F.2 成分（Aitchison）再分析Compositional (Aitchison) Reanalysis

因为覆盖范围是一个封闭的组合，所以将五个份额视为自由变量的分析严格来说并不合适，我们在这里报告单纯形讨论的组合分析（§Because coverage is a closed composition, an analysis that treats the five shares as free variables is not strictly appropriate, and we report here the compositional analysis the simplex discussion (§5.2）要求。在乘法替换零份额后，我们将每个分配映射到四个等距对数比 (ilr) 坐标，并在 42 个分配池（30 个扫描和保留分配加上附录的 12 个内部分配）上的 ilr 空间中的响应面上回归每个域的仅训练中期精度。) calls for. We map each allocation to four isometric log-ratio (ilr) coordinates after multiplicative replacement of zero shares, and regress each domain’s mid-training-only accuracy on a response surface in ilr space over the 42-allocation pool (the 30 sweep and held-out allocations plus the 12 interior allocations of AppendixB.2).

结果在两个方向上都提供了丰富的信息。完整的二次 ILR 曲面拟合良好（The result is informative in both directions. A full quadratic ilr surface fits well (R2=0.78R^{2}=0.78–0.960.9642 分配池上的每个域），这证实了在组合建模而不是边际建模时，分配携带真实信号。但它的驻点是每个域中的鞍点，而不是内部最大值，并且根据 42 个分配估计的 15 个二次项，Hessian 矩阵的确定性太弱，无法满足该分类的需要。没有交叉项（9 个参数）的简化曲面更加稳定且主要为凹面：20 个 iLR 曲率系数中有 15 个为负（逻辑 4 of 4；密码、操作和反事实 3 of 4；谜题 2 of 4），因此曲面在大多数方向上向下弯曲，但不是全部。per domain over the 42-allocation pool), which confirms that allocation carries real signal when modelled compositionally rather than marginally. But its stationary point is a saddle in every domain, not an interior maximum, and with 15 quadratic terms estimated from 42 allocations the Hessian is too weakly determined for that classification to carry weight. A reduced surface without cross terms (9 parameters) is more stable and predominantly concave: 15 of the 20 ilr curvature coefficients are negative (Logic 4 of 4; Cipher, Operation and Counterfactual 3 of 4; Puzzle 2 of 4), so the surface curves downward in most directions but not all.

因此，我们不主张相对于单纯形的联合内部最优。附录审核结果We therefore do not claim a joint interior optimum over the simplex. The moderation result of AppendixF.1是关于每个域边缘（每个域自己的覆盖带）的陈述，它基于无模型带比较和排列测试，这两者都不需要联合表面。建立联合组合最优需要比这里训练的 42 个更多的分配。附录12内部分配is a statement about per-domain marginals—each domain’s own coverage band—and it stands on the model-free band comparison and the permutation test, neither of which requires a joint surface. Establishing a joint compositional optimum would require more allocations than the 42 trained here. The 12 interior allocations of AppendixB.2正是为了测试这一点而添加的，并且没有产生联合最大值（每个域的驻点仍然是鞍点），因此我们将额外的单纯形覆盖率（而不是不同的估计量）标记为自然的下一个设计，而不是当前数据可以弥补的差距。were added precisely to test this and did not produce a joint maximum—every domain’s stationary point remained a saddle—so we flag additional simplex coverage, not a different estimator, as the natural next design rather than a gap the present data can close.

The external corpus draws 34.8% of its tokens from the ProofWriter rule family, the ZebraLogic family contributes 201 mid-training samples, and the reported isolation does not establish template- or rule-family-level disjointness. The associations may therefore reflect shared structure or exposure as well as mixture allocation. H.3 每户 ZebraLogic MCZebraLogic MC Per-House

表Table21报告 ZebraLogic MC 结果（MC = 多项选择），补充了 § 中的 ProofWriter 深度外推结果reports ZebraLogic MC results (MC = multiple-choice), complementing the ProofWriter depth-extrapolation result in §4.4。由于只有 201 个直接的中期训练 ZebraLogic 样本（0.3% 覆盖率），中期训练+SFT 在每个报告的房屋数量上都优于 SFT+RL。这与共享的形式推导和约束结构一致，但 ZebraLogic 是同族持有的暴露而不是分布外的转移测试，并且不能证明单独的小暴露就带来了收益。在本研究中，模板/家族水平的重叠仍然不受控制，零暴露复制是未来的工作。. With only 201 direct mid-training ZebraLogic samples (0.3% coverage), Mid-training+SFT outperforms SFT+RL at every reported house count. This is consistent with shared formal-deduction and constraint structure, but ZebraLogic is a same-family held-in exposure rather than an out-of-distribution transfer test, and it is not evidence that a small exposure alone caused the gains. Template/family-level overlap remains uncontrolled in this study, and a zero-exposure replication is future work.

The current report also does not fully separate coverage from unique-example diversity, repetition, sequence length, or external-corpus exposure; family/template-level decontamination and seed-level analyses of the full-pipeline rows are left for future work.

道德考虑。Ethical considerations.

这项工作研究了训练中期的数据混合设计。它不涉及人类主体或个人身份信息。所有语料库要么由确定性符号求解器生成，要么源自公开发布的基准。经过训练的模型是研究检查点，不适用于部署。基准平衡不应等同于已部署系统中的用户利益、安全性、校准或公平性；在高风险领域，低覆盖率可能会造成不均匀的风险，并且在部署之前需要针对特定​​领域的保证。This work studies data-mixture design for mid-training. It does not involve human subjects or personally identifiable information. All corpora are either generated by deterministic symbolic solvers or sourced from publicly released benchmarks. Trained models are research checkpoints not intended for deployment. Benchmark balance should not be equated with user benefit, safety, calibration, or fairness in a deployed system; in high-stakes domains, low coverage can create uneven risk and would require domain-specific assurance before deployment.
